doc.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: How long with each band; meeting George Russell
summary: Johnson's jobs ran two to three years each; he met George Russell as Benny Carter's drummer.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How long were you with Snookum Russell? Do you remember?

You know, for some strange reason, Lida, it seemed that things went in two to three year cycles for me. I was with Benny Carter for about two or three years. I was with Clarence Love for about that same length of time. I was with Basie about two years. I was with Benny Carter for about two or three years. I don’t know why it worked out that way, but it did.
Did you meet George Russell across this time? I can't remember if George was on . . .
Yeah, I met George Russell with Benny Carter. He was Benny Carter’s drummer for a while and a very good drummer.
He said 'till Max [Roach] made him give it up.
Yeah, I was trying to remember.

Yeah, that’s when I first met George Russell, when Benny hired him as a drummer. [He was a] good drummer. I knew nothing about his writing during those days. It was later that I learned about his . . .
I think he began writing after that.
